verified: In a typical self-consumption setup, solar helps cover the home's daytime electricity use.

verified: When solar generation is not enough, or at night without a battery, a grid-connected home still draws electricity from the grid.
Online fact check (owner waived the human reviewer): Meralco DER page states night import; DOE deck frames net-metering customers as monthly net users of grid power.
verified: Some bill charges do not simply disappear with solar.

Online fact check (owner waived the human reviewer): DOE net-metering deck confirms a PhP/customer/month supply and metering charge applies to net-metered customers, and exports are credited at the blended generation cost rather than the full retail rate, so not every charge is offset. Script stays generic (no peso amounts named).
verified: Installers should not promise an automatic zero bill.
Online fact check (owner waived the human reviewer): Follows from CL-03: per-customer charges plus lower export crediting mean a zero bill is not automatic.
